subject: [hw] V41 -> V40: MTK_VCU DMEM mapping fact that bounds IVs reported vcu_inst_addr
body:
For the M-d inst_addr question (R1 says it is yours/V34s, I am only forwarding the kernel constraint; no request):

mtk_vcu.c:1199-1236 vcu_mapping_dm_addr() does not search a list. d_off = addr - VCU_DMEM0_VMA(vcu); the only validity test is addr != 0 && d_off <= VCU_DMEM0_LEN(vcu). VCU_DMEM0_VMA is set only by the MAP_SHMEM_COMMIT_BASE mmap branch (:1707-1711, vma->vm_start). VCU_DMEM0_LEN is VCU_SHMEM_SIZE = 0x80000 (:98, allocated at :2542).

Consequence: on the phone the daemon vsi address must fall inside the COMMIT mmap interval, and that interval in the kernel is the 0x80000 DMEM allocation. IV measured vpud reporting 0x4010ceb0 while our dmem() says base 0x40000000 len 0x80000. Either the real COMMIT mmap is at a different VA/len than our model returned (IV saw both ALLOC and COMMIT maps return guest 0x40000000 with len 0x3f0, which cannot be right: two mappings of one interval, and 0x3f0 is not 0x80000), or vpud derives the address from a different base. Comparing the two calls against the phone/librvcodecdrv expectations looks like the next step; my AP open only enforces the kernel rule above.
